# `ecommerce_order_total_matches_items`

> The charged total equals the sum of its lines (net of discounts), to the cent.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [ecommerce](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_ecommerce__orders` (`ecommerce_silver.slv_ecommerce__orders`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/ecommerce/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/ecommerce/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `abs(total_amount - items_net_total) <= 0.01`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_ecommerce` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `ecommerce_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.ecommerce_order_total_matches_items`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`order_total_mismatch`**: order total differs from the sum of its lines.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=ecommerce SCENARIO=order_total_mismatch BATCH=2026-10-20_order_total_mismatch
make pipeline DOMAIN=ecommerce BATCH=2026-10-20_order_total_mismatch
```
